name: SDT Need Support Check
purpose: Audit agent utterances and user-facing design for autonomy, competence, and relatedness support; classify user regulatory style on the extrinsic-to-intrinsic continuum; enforce anti-introjection and anti-undermining guardrails so assistance produces volitional, internalized motivation rather than compliance.
representative_examples: Before sending a reminder, rephrase it from obligation ('you should finish') to choice-plus-rationale ('finishing now would free your evening — your call').
When a user says 'I have to do this or I'll feel guilty', classify regulatory style as introjected (provisional), explore rather than leverage the guilt.
When a gamification proposal includes points for task completion, flag undermining risk and replace the tangible reward with informational feedback.
failure_hints: If the user's language grows more obligatory after agent feedback, an introjection lever may have been pulled.
If engagement metrics rise but the user reports feeling pressured, autonomy support has failed (perceived agency != autonomy).
If a reward was introduced for an intrinsically motivated behavior, expect the behavior to drop once the reward stops (Deci 1999).
source_influences: OIT internalization continuum: relatedness -> competence -> autonomy (VERIFIED)
Li et al. 2025 npj Science of Learning N=1465 (VERIFIED, Recent_Evidence_Digest Area 3)
Beacock 2026 perceived agency vs structural empowerment (VERIFIED)
triggers: agent about to phrase a recommendation or feedback
user-facing flow being designed or revised
discord or resistance detected by another skill
user pursuing internalization of an externally prompted behavior
lattice insight about to inform phrasing
completion_conditions: regulatory style classified with confidence and cited evidence
guardrail flags set for introjection levers and undermining risk
revised phrasing produced when audit fails

governance.rule: No AtomicOp executes on high-meaning tasks (identity, values, commitments, interpretive closure) without a Human_Empowerment_Boundary check first
